picture-pairs.name: Doiq ralbienz
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Youx doiq ralbienz vih boux miz bingh sitceiq: Doiq ralbienz
picture-pairs.h1: Doiq ralbienz: Youx doiq ralbienz ndei yaep
picture-pairs.description: Aen youx doiq ralbienz mbouj aeu sen, ndei yaep vih boux miz bingh sitceiq. Ralbienz hung caenh yawj raemx, mbouj miz biu dingzgih roxnaeuz faensoiq, mwngz coux gaenq aeu 4 daengz 12 bienz.
picture-pairs.short: Ra song aen ralbienz doxtungq. Ralbienz ndaej caenh ciuq roengz.
picture-pairs.intro: Diemj aen ralbienz ndeu, laeng haenx diemj aen ralbienz doxtungq de. Ralbienz caenh ciuq roengz coux gyoengq de, cawq mbouj aeu geiq doengz. Mwh song aen ralbienz doxtungq hwnj daeuj, de coux miz rim kim caeuq daeg gouq.
howTo: Gaenq aeu gij bienz ralbienz lae. Bonj song song (4 bienz) coux heuh baez ndei raemx.
Diemj ralbienz aen lae doh ndaej. De coux miz rim kim hwnj daeuj.
Diemj aen ralbienz yawj doxtungq haenx. Song aen ralbienz neix coux doiq gyaep caeuq daeg gouq.
Tep song aen ralbienz mbouj doxtungq, yaep mbouj miz matyaez mbouj ndei fatseng. Mwh mwngz coux ndei coux diemj baez laeng.
Coux cix bat “Ralbienz ndip” mwh song boux mwngz roemx aeu gij ciuqdoengz daep roengz.
tips: Haeux ciuq mingz ralbienz doxgah caeuq daeuj goj: “Aen wan caz boiq. Mwngz gya noemh hoemq caz lox?”
Luengh boux mwngz ciuqgu diemj aeu, lij aeu yaep lai mwh. Cij bienz mbouj aeu diemj daep de.
Youx 4 bienz cix gij yaep mwh faenx sim. Bienz lai lai haenx coux gaenq aeu, mbouj cij aeu baezbaez daengz.
Youx daengz mwh lij wanx coux doemq roengz. Youx baez ndeu coux aen huoddoengh cienzbaenj.

faq.q: Miz biu dingzgih roxnaeuz faensoiq lox?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz biu dingzgih, faensoiq, biu geiq diemj roxnaeuz baih. Mwngz ndaej doemq youx gwnz gizlae doh ndaej, doemq youx buenqdaengx coux aen fangjfap doemq ndei raemx.

faq.q: Mwhciengx ralbienz caenh ciuq roengz mbouj daep?
faq.a: Caenh ciuq ralbienz roengz haenx bienq youx baenz yawj caeuq doiq, mbouj aeu geiq doengz. Boux lai lai naeuz neix ndei raemx. Mwngz diemj baez ndeu ndaej bienq baenz ralbienz ndip mwh mwngz roemx.

faq.q: De mbouj aeu sen lox, lij gou aeu ndanghaeh lox?
faq.a: Aen, mbouj aeu sen, mbouj aeu canghauh, ndanghaeh roxnaeuz haehroengz. De ndaej youx gwnz liuqlanjgi gwnz soujgi, bingzbanj roxnaeuz denhnauj.

faq.q: Raeuz ndaej aeu ralbienz ranz raeuz lox?
faq.a: Ndaej. Yiengh Doiq ralbienz ranz, ndaej aeu ralbienz youq gwnz sezbei mwngz. Gij ralbienz neix youq gwnz liuqlanjgi mwngz, mbouj sangcuanz bae gizlae.

find-the-same.name: Ra aen doxtungq
find-the-same.seoTitle: Ra aen ralbienz doxtungq: Youx riengz vih boux miz bingh sitceiq
find-the-same.description: Aen ralbienz ndeu youq gwnz, song daengz seiq aen youq laj. Diemj aen doxtungq haenx. Aen youx ralbienz mbouj aeu sen, ndei raemx vih boux miz bingh sitceiq, mbouj miz biu dingzgih.
find-the-same.short: Yawj ralbienz youq gwnz, diemj aen doxtungq youq laj.
find-the-same.intro: Aen ralbienz dan ndeu youq gwnz moek. Youq laj de miz song, sam roxnaeuz seiq aen ralbienz. Diemj aen doxtungq haenx. Baez ndeu cix gaenq aeu aen ndeu, miz gyaep doxgah goj lai lai.
howTo: Gaenq aeu song, sam roxnaeuz seiq aen ralbienz daeuj gaenq. Song aen coux riengz raemx.
Yawj aen ralbienz youq gwnz doxgah.
Diemj aen ralbienz doxtungq youq laj. De miz daeg gouq caeuq gij vah unq raemx.
Tep diemj aen ralbienz mbouj doxtungq, aen youx cix heuh mingz de laeng coux lae. Mwngz guh riengz riengz.
Diemj “Ralbienz laeng” mwh mwngz coux ndei aeu aen ndeu.
tips: Goj gij ralbienz gvaq laeng coux gaenq: saek, dohsik, gizlae ndaej raemx.
Song aen gaenq haenx mbouj dwg “riengz lai”. Mukbiuh coux dwg yaep mwh wanx, mbouj dwg aeu gaenx.
Tep diemj mbouj faenx, boux haenx ndaej cij bienz, mwngz diemj daep de doh ndaej.

faq.q: Miz biu dingzgih roxnaeuz faensoiq lox?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz biu dingzgih, faensoiq, biu geiq diemj roxnaeuz baih. Mwngz ndaej doemq youx gwnz gizlae doh ndaej, doemq youx buenqdaengx coux aen fangjfap doemq ndei raemx.

faq.q: Tep diemj loek ralbienz yaep miz matyaez fatseng?
faq.a: Mbouj miz matyaez mbouj ndei. Mbouj miz sing lingz, daeg cag deng roxnaeuz ndin. Aen youx heuh mingz ralbienz deng diemj haenx, laeng coux lae baez diemj laeng.

faq.q: De mbouj aeu sen lox, lij gou aeu ndanghaeh lox?
faq.a: Aen, mbouj aeu sen, mbouj aeu canghauh, ndanghaeh roxnaeuz haehroengz. De ndaej youx gwnz liuqlanjgi gwnz soujgi, bingzbanj roxnaeuz denhnauj.

shadow-match.name: Doiq ral
shadow-match.seoTitle: Youx doiq ral vih boux miz bingh sitceiq: Mbouj aeu sen vangjsang
shadow-match.h1: Doiq ral: Youx ralbienz ndei yaep
shadow-match.description: Ral dumyouq youq gwnz, song daengz seiq aen ralbienz youq laj. Diemj aen ralbienz ok ral haenx. Aen youx doiq ral mbouj aeu sen, ndei yaep vih boux miz bingh sitceiq, mbouj miz biu dingzgih.
shadow-match.short: Yawj ral haenx laeng diemj aen ralbienz ok de daeuj.
shadow-match.intro: Doiq ral dwg aen huoddoengh baeukuh youq gwnz cej in, youq neix miz ralbienz hung mbouj aeu in cej. Ral unq ndeu youq gwnz moek, song, sam roxnaeuz seiq aen ralbienz lae youq laj. Diemj aen ralbienz ok ral haenx. Dohsik yiengh daegcez, romq roxnaeuz wan caz doh riengz daeuj goj.
howTo: Gaenq aeu song, sam roxnaeuz seiq aen ralbienz daeuj gaenq. Song aen coux riengz raemx.
Yawj ral doxgah. De dwg dohsik matyaez? Sang roxnaeuz moenx?
Diemj aen ralbienz ok ral haenx. Mingz de coux hwnj youq laj ral.
Tep diemj aen ralbienz mbouj doxtungq, aen youx cix heuh mingz de laeng coux lae. Mwngz guh riengz riengz.
Diemj “Ral laeng” mwh mwngz coux ndei aeu aen ndeu.
tips: Aeu faenxniux vawz rim ral laeng coux goj gij dohsik de.
Tep ral vanz neix yawj yaep naek, bienq bae Ra aen doxtungq, gizhaenx ralbienz yawj doxtungq.
Mwh ra ndaej coux goj gij ralbienz haenx: “Raeuz gvaqgonq miz aen romq yiengh neix.”

faq.q: Miz biu dingzgih roxnaeuz faensoiq lox?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz biu dingzgih, faensoiq, biu geiq diemj roxnaeuz baih. Mwngz ndaej doemq youx gwnz gizlae doh ndaej, doemq youx buenqdaengx coux aen fangjfap doemq ndei raemx.

faq.q: Doiq iengx miz ickawx doiq boux miz bingh lumz lwi?
faq.a: Doiq sam-faenh boux, daegbied dwg ndaw seizgeiz daih-it, de ndaej baenz aen hozdung hungzndwen, gaanjdanj ndeu. Hingzfaeh gaeuq vaij rox san-saw. De dwg yungh daeuj luenh-yied caeuq gangj-ueh, mbouj dwg gij gaujsi, lij mbouj saej bingh lumz ndei hwnjdaeuj roxnaeuz ienx manh roengzdaeuj. Lauxfaenh de baenz sim yawz, cix caep aen «Haj aen doengz» roxnaeuz dazyienz yawj gij vah caemhcungx.

faq.q: Lauxfaenh diemj loek vah cix baenz lau?
faq.a: Mbouj miz gijmaz mbouj suenghsim. Mbouj miz sing lingz, gah-cawz boengz roxnaeuz iengx dondat. Youzyi cix gouh mingz vah de hwnjdaeuj, laengneix ciuqbae deng mwngz diemj.

faq.q: Mbouj au cienz lwi, aeu daengjgeiq mbouj?
faq.a: Dwg, mbouj au cienz, lij mbouj aeu danghoq, daengjgeiq roxnaeuz haehcaj. Yungh liujlanjsi ndaw soujgei, bingzbanj roxnaeuz dienhnauj coux ndaej yungh.

sort-together.name: Caemhcungx faenbui
sort-together.seoTitle: Youzyi Faenbui Doiqqyaep Boux Miz Bingh Lumz: Caemhcungx Faenbui
sort-together.h1: Caemhcungx Faenbui: Aen Hozdung Faenbui Vah
sort-together.description: Diemj vah ndeu, laengneix diemj aen loeng de danghnaeuz: ranz-gwn roxnaeuz suen-va, maej-faeiz roxnaeuz doengzvuz. Aen hozdung faenbui angq-angq, mbouj au cienz doiq boux miz bingh lumz.
sort-together.short: Ciuh aen vah caep roengz aen loeng de: ranz-gwn roxnaeuz suen-va, lij miz gijwnq.
sort-together.intro: Faenbui dwg aen gungcoz moix ngoenz bienq guh lij suenghsim, doengzbaenz sou gij gaeq daeuj roxnaeuz doiq va. Diemj vah ndeu, laengneix diemj aen loeng de danghnaeuz. Mbouj aeu ciz, mbouj miz loek.
howTo: Genx aen cuwdaez: ranz-gwn caeuq suen-va, maej-faeiz caeuq doengzvuz, roxnaeuz ranz caeuq luyouh.
Diemj aen vah ndeu. De cix miz bian rim-gim.
Diemj aen loeng de danghnaeuz. Vah cix ienx bae ndaw aen loeng haenx.
Lauxfaenh de danghnaeuz aen loeng wnq, youzyi cix vumzvunz gangj hwnjdaeuj lij ciuqbae deng.
Dangzmoix aen vah faenbui le, caemhcungx yawj gij ndaw loeng.
tips: Ndaw sangh-hoh ciengzcangz mbouj miz daeb-loek. Lauxfaenh miz boux naeuz aen hu doq namx danghnaeuz ranz-gwn, cix cam de gohyienh. Sou ndaej dingx aen go-sê ndei ndeu.
Yungh gij vah daeuj dae: "Mwngz ndaw suen-va boek gijmaz?"
Faenbui gij gaeq cin-cingq, doengzbaenz faemx caeuq ca, roxnaeuz goj-aep ciuq saek, dwg aen hozdung ndei liax daiz dienhnauj.

faq.q: Miz gi-seiz roxnaeuz fwn-soq lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz cung, fwn-soq, soq buhkau roxnaeuz baih. Mwngz ndaej dengz ndaw seizgeiz gah hanh, dingx ndaw cawx goj dwg aen leix-leux ndei ndeu.

faq.q: Gohmaz aeu faenbui?
faq.a: Lai boux gyaez faenbui, vawjviensang de lumj gungcoz miz ickawx lij rox-naj. Ciuqbaih guh ciuqbaih gangj gij vah goj gaanjdanj.

faq.q: Mbouj au cienz lwi, aeu daengjgeiq mbouj?
faq.a: Dwg, mbouj au cienz, lij mbouj aeu danghoq, daengjgeiq roxnaeuz haehcaj. Yungh liujlanjsi ndaw soujgei, bingzbanj roxnaeuz dienhnauj coux ndaej yungh.

picture-puzzle.name: Baep vah
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Youzyi Baep Vah Gaanjdanj Doiqqyaep Boux Miz Bingh Lumz: 4 roxnaeuz 9 Doek
picture-puzzle.h1: Baep Vah: Aen Baep Vah Gaanjdanj
picture-puzzle.description: Aen baep vah fangz-lianj gaanjdanj doiq boux miz bingh lumz: 4 roxnaeuz 9 doek hung, aen vah daengx aen cijengz yawj ndaej, diemj song doek cix ndaej hoenx doengx.
picture-puzzle.short: Diemj song doek daeuj hoenx doengx, daengz aen vah caemhcungx baenz ndei.
picture-puzzle.intro: Aen vah ndei yawj ndeu deng cet baenz seiq roxnaeuz gouj doek hung lij luanh le. Aen vah daengx aen cijengz yawj ndaej daeuj baenz caemjcoux. Diemj aen doek ndeu, laengneix diemj aen wnq, song doek cix hoenx viqdiz. Mbouj aeu laek bae.
howTo: Genx aen vah caeuq 4 roxnaeuz 9 doek. Seiq doek dwg aen laeb-daeuz vumzvunz.
Yawj daengx aen vah youq bae-gwnz.
Diemj aen doek ndeu, laengneix diemj aen viqdiz de wngdang bae. Song doek cix hoenx doengx.
Doek youq viqdiz deng-cawz miz aen maeg gouj iq ndeu.
Dangz aen vah baenz ndei le, caemhcungx yiemq-yied yawj, laengneix genx aen wnq.
tips: Diemj song doek daeuj hoenx doengx, doiq lai boux daeuj naeuz gaeuq laek gaanjdanj lai.
Ciuqbaih baep ciuqbaih gangj aen vah: "Aen rim-ranz nding youq haenx."
Aen baep vah faex cin-cingq miz 12 daengz 24 doek hung goj dwg hozdung baenz-yied youq gwnz daiz.

faq.q: Miz gi-seiz roxnaeuz fwn-soq lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz cung, fwn-soq, soq buhkau roxnaeuz baih. Mwngz ndaej dengz ndaw seizgeiz gah hanh, dingx ndaw cawx goj dwg aen leix-leux ndei ndeu.

faq.q: Aeu laek gij doek vah lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj aeu. Diemj aen doek ndeu, laengneix diemj aen wnq, song de cix hoenx viqdiz. Guh baenzneix doiq fwen faeiz iq roxnaeuz mwnh-bingz iq gaeuq gaanjdanj.

faq.q: Mbouj au cienz lwi, aeu daengjgeiq mbouj?
faq.a: Dwg, mbouj au cienz, lij mbouj aeu danghoq, daengjgeiq roxnaeuz haehcaj. Yungh liujlanjsi ndaw soujgei, bingzbanj roxnaeuz dienhnauj coux ndaej yungh.

finish-the-saying.name: Daem vah-dauq
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Daem Vah-dauq: Youzyi Vah-dauq Doiqqyaep Boux Laux
finish-the-saying.description: Gij vah-dauq rox-naj miz aen vah laeng doek, lumjnaeuz "A penny saved is a penny ___". Diemj aen genx roxnaeuz haek ok aen laeng de, laengneix caemhcungx gangj-ueh.
finish-the-saying.short: Caemhcungx daem gij vah-dauq rox-naj, laengneix caemhcungx gangj-ueh.
finish-the-saying.intro: Gij vah-cawz laux ciengzcangz rox daengz bak bi. Moix aen gya-kat baenj aen vah-dauq rox-naj miz aen vah laeng doek, sam aen genx, caeuq aen biujciw "Haek ok aen laeng". Haek ok aen laeng le, miz aen cam vumzvunz daeuj cauh ueh.
howTo: Caemhcungx doeg aen vah-dauq haenx ok sing.
Diemj aen vah daem de, roxnaeuz diemj "Haek ok aen laeng".
Doeg daengx aen vah-dauq ndeu lij ciuq aen dae daeuj gangj-ueh.
Cunhbeiq ndei le, diemj "Aen vah-dauq laengneix".
tips: Doeg manh-manh lij youq gonq aen vah laeng dingx ndeu. Ciengzcangz mwngz lij mbouj doeg le de coux gangj ok le.
Lauxfaenh miz boux gangj aen laeng mbouj doengz, coux suenghsim aeu. Gij leix-leux vah-dauq ndaw ranz roxnaeuz aen dieg doengz mbouj doengz.
Youq ndaw doenz boux, boux ndeu doeg lij daengx doenz caemhcungx daem aen laeng.

faq.q: Miz gi-seiz roxnaeuz fwn-soq lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz cung dinghsiz, deifwn, suenq bujcawz, hix mbouj miz suengh baih. Mwngz yienzheih dingz cungx ndaej, dingz youq gyang roeg hix dwg aen fuengwfap bae liux ndei.

faq.q: Toxgonq dou genx aen vah mbouj doengz ne yaengx?
faq.a: Guhcaemz yaemh ciuq laeuz aen gietgoj ciengzcangz, laengne bae daeuj daemq vah. Mbouj miz deifwn, daeb aen vah mbouj doengz hix ndei.

faq.q: Guhcaemz ne mbouj aeu cienz le, gou aeu danghgi mbouj?
faq.a: Dwg, mbouj aeu cienz, hix mbouj aeu cawzhoq, danghgi roxbaez haehcaiq. Mwngz yungh sauqlaemz youq souji, bingzbanj roxbaez dienhnauj cungx ndaej yungh.

word-search.name: Ra cih cawj daih
word-search.seoTitle: Ra Cih Cawj Daih Cingh Boux Miz Bingh Siiqceh, Ndaej In
word-search.description: Aen guhcaemz ra cih cawj daih mbouj aeu cienz cingh boux laux caeuq boux miz bingh siiqceh. Cih noix, cawj daih, cih danq miz heiq hengz caeuq heiq suq. Ndaej guh youq vangj roxbaez in okdaeuj.
word-search.short: Cawj daih, cih noix, danq miz heiq hengz caeuq heiq suq. Hix ndaej in okdaeuj.
word-search.intro: Aen bangz iq miz cawj daih caeuq geij aen cih xwnh, cungx dwg ciuq heiq hengz roxbaez heiq suq daeuj doeg. Diemj aen cawj daegog aen cih, laengne diemj aen cawj laeng loek de. He haeuj aeu cej? Diemj baez ndeu couh ndaej in aen daeg moq.
howTo: Genx aen cujti caeuq gveiqgawz bangz.
Yawj dan cih. Cih dwg ciuq heiq hengz (swix daeuj gvaz) roxbaez heiq suq (gwnz daeuj laj) daeuj doeg.
Diemj aen cawj daegog aen cih, laengne diemj aen cawj laeng loek de.
Aen cih ra ndaej couh aeu saek leix okdaeuj, hix gouq ok dan cih.
Diemj "In aen daeg ne", couh ndaej yungh yenzbit roxbaez bit mak youq cej guh.
tips: Ci aen cih youq dan cih, caez ra aen cawj daegog de.
Youq gwnz cej, bit leixsaek comh rox vih yenzbit.
Daemq aen cih cujti ne. Cih makmaig dwg aen laeuz daeuj naeuz daengz cinghsaem riep mak, hamh roxbaez bae haih.

faq.q: Miz cung dinghsiz roxbaez fwn mbouj?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz cung dinghsiz, deifwn, suenq bujcawz, hix mbouj miz suengh baih. Mwngz yienzheih dingz cungx ndaej, dingz youq gyang roeg hix dwg aen fuengwfap bae liux ndei.

faq.q: Gou ndaej in aen ra cih ne okdaeuj mbouj?
faq.a: Ndaej. Diemj "In aen daeg ne" couh ndaej aeu cawj daih in bangz ne okdaeuj, laj de miz dan cih. Moix aen daeg moq cungx mbouj doengz.

faq.q: Guhcaemz ne mbouj aeu cienz le, gou aeu danghgi mbouj?
faq.a: Dwg, mbouj aeu cienz, hix mbouj aeu cawzhoq, danghgi roxbaez haehcaiq. Mwngz yungh sauqlaemz youq souji, bingzbanj roxbaez dienhnauj cungx ndaej yungh.

coloring.name: Yiep saek iengh
coloring.seoTitle: Yiep Saek Iengh Cingh Boux Laebnyinh Miz Bingh Siiqceh (Mbouj Aeu Cienz)
coloring.description: Aen iengh yiep saek cingh boux laebnyinh, gij aen gvangq hix ginqdanh: diemj aen saek, laengne diemj gwnz iengh. Mbouj lau ndoj laeglaeg, mbouj miz saek loek, moix yieb cej cungx ndaej in mbouj aeu cienz.
coloring.short: Diemj aen saek, laengne diemj aen iengh. Hix ndaej in cej okdaeuj.
coloring.intro: Cej miz hingzsik daih hix ginqdanh: ndoengxva youq bwnh, ranz ndeu, fanzcah ndeu, mbaepnbaj ndeu caeuq ruzlaemz ndeu. Diemj aen saek, laengne diemj gwnz aen iengh couh ndaej buh saek. Mbouj miz saek loek.
howTo: Genx aen cej ndeu.
Diemj aen saek. Moix aen saek cungx miz mingz cih de.
Diemj gwnz iengh couh buh aen saek haenx haeujbae.
Mwngz yienzheih siengj bienq, gamhdaeuj buh aen saek moq haeujbae hix ndaej.
Diemj "In aen cej ne" couh ndaej in cej haeuj okdaeuj, yungh yenzbit roxbaez bit mak daeuj yiep saek.
tips: Lauxsaemh genx laeglaeg le, ndaej aeu song aen saek hawj de genx, mbouj aeu aeu daengx aen.
Maiq saek ceij roxbaez taengzngwenz saek laemx cungx ndei. Ne dwg vih aen hwnqhung saek, mbouj dwg vih ceng daekcaeq.
Cej in okdaeuj ne yungh bit mak na roxbaez bit laxbwn yiep saek ndei, comh daeb hix gvaiz.

faq.q: Miz cung dinghsiz roxbaez fwn mbouj?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz cung dinghsiz, deifwn, suenq bujcawz, hix mbouj miz suengh baih. Mwngz yienzheih dingz cungx ndaej, dingz youq gyang roeg hix dwg aen fuengwfap bae liux ndei.

faq.q: Gij cej ne miz saeuh lwgnyez lai mbouj?
faq.a: Dou veiq gij aen dienhdingh caeuq ginqdanh, mbouj veiq manhva, couh dwg vih aeu hap boux laebnyinh. Hingzsik daih hawj yiep saek ginqdanh, hix mbouj lumj lwgnyez.

faq.q: Guhcaemz ne mbouj aeu cienz le, gou aeu danghgi mbouj?
faq.a: Dwg, mbouj aeu cienz, hix mbouj aeu cawzhoq, danghgi roxbaez haehcaiq. Mwngz yungh sauqlaemz youq souji, bingzbanj roxbaez dienhnauj cungx ndaej yungh.

conversation-cards.name: Kaj daemq vah
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Vah Daemq Cingh Boux Miz Bingh Siiqceh: Kaj Iengh
conversation-cards.description: Kaj iengh miz vah daemq onq-oet cingh boux miz bingh siiqceh: mbouj hawj gauj, mbouj miz daeb daekcaeq. Ndaej yungh youq bingz roxbaez in daengx buhsik okdaeuj.
conversation-cards.short: Kaj iengh miz vah daemq honhhonh caeuq onq-oet. Mbouj hawj gauj.
conversation-cards.intro: Moix aen kaj cungx miz iengh siengx caeuq vah daemq honhhonh, lumjbaenz "Mwngz he aeu gij dingz deocienh lawz?" Mbouj miz daeb daekcaeq, hix mbouj aeu geiq aen maz. Genx aen cujti ndeu roxbaez siemj daengxbolex.
howTo: Genx aen cujti ndeu, roxbaez giengz "Daengx aen kaj".
Aeu heiq daih doeg aen vah daemq, caez yawj iengh.
Dingiq, naeuz daeb gouq mwngz, hawj vah daemq laepdaep bae.
Mwh baenz le diemj "Kaj laeng loek", roxbaez youq aen kaj ne giengz geij laux cungx ndaej.
Diemj "In daengx aen kaj" couh ndaej in okdaeuj daet cej.
tips: Gouq mwngz hix daeb aen vah daemq ne. Lumjbaenz daemq vah, mbouj lumj hoifangj.
Ciuq aen goqsêiq bae, mbouj aeu ceng aen laebsoek. Gij aen iq bienq hix mbouj guhmaz.
Lauxsaemh aen kaj ne daeuj naeuz daengz aen cungj yaek roengz ndang, aeu hiuq saem de, laengne onq-oet bae aen kaj moq.

faq.q: Vihmaz mbouj miz aen vah daemq "Mwngz hix geiq ndaej... mbouj?"
faq.a: Vah daemq gauj aen geiq ndaej lumjbaenz gaujsi, hawj boux lauxsaemh naeuz loek. Vah daemq honhhonh lumjbaenz "Naeuz daengz... hawj gou dingiq" hawj moix boux cungx caez daeuj, geiq ndaej geijlaux cungx ndaej.

faq.q: Gou ndaej in kaj okdaeuj mbouj?
faq.a: Ndaej. "In daengx aen kaj" aeu cawj daih in daengx buhsik okdaeuj, moix yieb cej miz geij aen kaj, ndaej daet okdaeuj.

faq.q: Guhcaemz ne mbouj aeu cienz le, gou aeu danghgi mbouj?
faq.a: Coengh, de mbouj aeu cienz, lij mbouj aeu danghhoh, danghcwqs roxnaeuz haicai. Youq ndaw liujlangjgi soujgi, bingjbanj roxnaeuz dienhnao couh yungh ndaej.

photo-pairs.name: Cawq cauhbieuz
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Aeu Cauhbieuz Ndaw Ranz Guh Youzyisi Baehcawq
photo-pairs.description: Aeu cauhbieuz ndaw ranz bienq baenz youzyisi baehcawq ndei-singz. Gwnz seiqbi mwngz ghaeuq 2 daengz 6 buhs cauhbieuz; gyoengqde cix youq ndaw liujlangjgi mwngz, cungj mbouj wnghsang.
photo-pairs.short: Ghaeuq cauhbieuz ciuqseh bae baehcawq. Mbouj miz maz wnghsang.
photo-pairs.intro: Cangq soujgi, bingjbanj roxnaeuz dienhnao ghaeuq song daengz loeg buhs cauhbieuz, gyoengqde couh bienq baenz youzyisi baehcawq miz cauhbieuz hung lwnh. Cauhbieuz caemncik youq ndaw yieb neix heauq okdaeuj. Mbouj wnghsang, mbouj soucanz, mbouj funghsiengj, hoeng bae yieb neix couh mbouj lij miz lo.
howTo: Nyeiq "Ghaeuq cauhbieuz" rox couh ghaeuq song daengz loeg buhs cauhbieuz.
Muensik buhs cauhbieuz cungj okdaeuj song baez. Nyeiq aeu buhs ndeu, laengneix nyeiq aeu buhs cawq de.
Ra rox buhs ndeu couh gangj daengz buhs ndeu.
Liux le, bae yieb neix roxnaeuz nyeiq "Ciengz cauhbieuz". Maz cungj mbouj liuz.
tips: Ghaeuq cauhbieuz ndat mbw loekmiz gwnz gij saeh riengzroengh, roxgyaek: doxguh, suenhoh, dieg hoengq, ngoenz gyaeundei.
Cauhbieuz dieg caeuq doxgaiq ndaej gvaq cauhbieuz naeuh ranz doxdin, lij mbouj miet aeu heuh minzcwh gyoengqboux.
Lauxnaeuz cauhbieuz boux gvaqseiq ndaej baenz simnaenh, couh mbouj aeu ghaeuq, cujbifei mwngz roxnaeuz gyoengqde baenz ndaej sim'on.

faq.q: Cauhbieuz gou miz wnghsang bae dieg'wnq lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj. Yieb neix cix youq ndaw liujlangjgi mwngz doeg cauhbieuz mwngz ghaeuq, lij heauq youq gwnz yinghmuk. Gyoengqde mbouj song daengz dou roxnaeuz boux'wnq, bae yieb roxnaeuz cungxsin gaiq yieb couh mbouj lij miz lo.

faq.q: Miz geiqsiz roxnaeuz geiqfaen lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj miz. Mbouj miz geiqsiz, geiqfaen, geiq baez roxnaeuz suet. Mwngz saejgiz hwnjdaeuj dingx cungj ndaej, dingx youq henjroen couh baenz ngoenz liux ndei ndeu.

faq.q: Gou ndaej soucanz youzyisi neix vih baezlaeng yungh lwi?
faq.a: Youq ndaw liujlangjgi mbouj ndaej sou, neix hedoek sehgiz vih mbouj soucanz gij saeh ciuqseh. Apu Golden Moments mienhfei vih iPhone caeuq iPad ndaej liuz cauhcungz buhs cauhbieuz mwngz ghaeuq youq gwnz seiqbi mwngz.

picture-bingo.name: Cauhbieuz bingo
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Cauhbieuz Bingo Vih Bouxceiq Miz Cingzhingz Caehsou: Ndaej Doyin
picture-bingo.description: Cauhbieuz bingo mienhfei ndaej doyin vih bouxceiq caeuq gyoengq boux aeu boux baujguenx gwnz sim, miz bouxheuh hung gwnz yinghmuk. Cauhbieuz hung lij miz saw, 9 roxnaeuz 16 lwgfanh, mbouj aeu doeg saw cungj ndaej guh.
picture-bingo.short: Kaj cauhbieuz bingo ndaej doyin caeuq bouxheuh yinghmuk hung vih gyoengq boux.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo gvangsik yungh cauhbieuz daeuj thaei sousoh, couh mbouj aeu bouxlawz doeg saw iq. Doyin aeu yiengh kaj doxbwt, laengneix yungh bouxheuh gwnz yinghmuk aeu cauhbieuz hung heauq youq gwnz dienhsi, dienhnao roxnaeuz bingjbanj.
howTo: Ghaeuq muensik kaj miz 9 roxnaeuz 16 lwgfanh, caeuq geijlai boux doxcawz.
Nyeiq "Doyin kaj". Muensik kaj cungj doxbwt.
Youq gwnz yinghmuk hung hai bouxheuh. Nyeiq "Cauhbieuz laeng" daeuj heauq muensik cauhbieuz caeuq minzcwh de.
Gyoengq boux doxcawz aeu tongcienz, nyouj roxnaeuz cizheuh bae dam cauhbieuz doxtungz gwnz kaj de.
Bouxlawz diemx mwnx yit hangz roxnaeuz gvaeng kaj, cungj ndaej gyoengqboux hoqheuh. Youzyisi baezneix mbouj miz boux suet: liuh dox guh daengz muensik boux cungj diemx mwnx yit hangz.
tips: Yungh gij doxgaiq hung dam, lumbaenz cizgi roxnaeuz gaeb buendit. Nyouj iq caix ndaej roep.
Heuh minzcwh cauhbieuz lij gangj geij gouq: "Yit soek ruz buem. Bouxlawz gvaq ruz lwi?"
Boux haidaeux mbouj ndei naengh gyaep yinghmuk, boux doxcawz aeu boux bang couh cawq song boux.
Doiq geijlai gyoengq boux daengz gangj, gouj lwgfanh couh daihdoek lo. Cingqyouzyisi liuz youq 20 daengz 30 faencungh couh ndei.

faq.q: Youq ndaw ranz bouxceiq gou guh cauhbieuz bingo panzlawz?
faq.a: Muensik boux doxcawz doyin yit kaj, aeu bouxheuh boengz youq yinghmuk hung ciengx, caemncik heuh cauhbieuz caeuq minzcwh de. Guh daengz muensik boux cungj diemx mwnx yit hangz, mbouj liuz bouxlawz.

faq.q: Doyin aeu cienz lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj aeu cienz. Mwngz aeu geijlai couh doyin geijlai, aeu baezlawz cungj ndaej, yungh ndaw ranz roxnaeuz yungh gyoengq boux cungj ndaej.

faq.q: Mbouj doeg saw ndaej guh lwi?
faq.a: Ndaej. Muensik lwgfanh cungj dwg cauhbieuz hung, gizlaj lij miz minzcwh vih gyoengq boux hoengq doeg saw.

calm-breathing.name: Hoep heiq sim'on
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Yit Baez Hoep Heiq Sim'on Vih Bouxceiq Caeuq Boux Guenxbauj
calm-breathing.description: Yit baez hoep heiq yienz caeuq cingsing vih doxgvanh: voenz ndeu hoep loeg baez heiq laengneix hung hwnj caeuq iq loeg. Mwngz hai de, saejgiz dingx cungj ndaej.
calm-breathing.short: Voenz yienz bae hoep heiq doxcang. Hai caeuq dingx ciuq sim mwngz.
calm-breathing.intro: Mizsae gij doxguh ndei ciengx dwg yit baez cingsing. Nyeiq "Hai", voenz hung hwnj couh hoep heiq haeuj, voenz iq loeg couh boet heiq ok. Ghaeuq faix roxnaeuz yienz. Neix mbouj dwg yihliuz, cix dwg yit cingq cingsing vih doxgvanh.
howTo: Naengh gyaep cank ndei-singz.
Ghaeuq faixyienz: yienz roxnaeuz on.
Nyeiq "Hai". Voenz hung hwnj couh hoep heiq haeuj, voenz iq loeg couh boet heiq ok.
Hoep loeg baez heiq le de cawz dingx, roxnaeuz saejgiz nyeiq "Dingx" cungj ndaej.
tips: Lauxnaeuz boux de hoengq, bae kam fwt roxnaeuz aeu fwt boengz gwnz gieng boux de.
Mbouj aeu miet. Lauxnaeuz gyoengqde cix hoengq yawj, couh ndei lo.
Lauxnaeuz boux miz heiq mbouj saenq, couh hoep heiq ciuq gvangsik lij yawj voenz couh ndaej. Miz maz saeh heiq mbouj saenq couh bae sam yisi.

faq.q: Neix dwg yihliuz hoep heiq lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj dwg. Neix dwg yit baez cingsing caeuq doxcawz gienjdanh, aeu rox mbouj aeu ciuq sim. Mbouj dwg gij fap yihliuz gij maz dingzvangz roxnaeuz bingh. Miz saeh ndanghangx couh bae gangj caeuq yisi.

faq.q: Gou mbouj hai de, voenz neix cawz yiengh lwi?
faq.a: Mbouj. Mwngz mbouj nok Start couh mbouj miz maz dongh, roemx heiq loek baez liux roxnaeuz mwngz nok Stop de couh dingz. Dangxnieqs saedbei mwngz sietciengq geijsieu donghvaq, saw couh bienq hoeng aen yienz mbouj bienq hung.

faq.q: De mienjfih lwg mbouj, lij aeu danghci mbouj?
faq.a: Dox, de mienjfih, lij mbouj miz ciengqhoh, mbouj aeu danghci roxnaeuz hahcaeh. Youq liuxlanygi gwnz soujgi, bingzbanj roxnaeuz denhnauj couh ndaej sawj.
